newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan buys 500,000T of wheat, 350,000 from U.S..
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys 500,000T of wheat, 350,000 from U.S..

text.p: Pakistan bought 500,000 tonnes of wheat early Thursday, including 350,000 tonnes from the United States, 100,000 from Australia and 50,000 from Canada, said U.S. grain exporters said.
The Pakistan embassy confirmed the deal and said shipment was for July 11 to August 10.

Sellers included Louis Dreyfus, Cargill, the Canadian Wheat Board, Marubeni in Australia and the U.S., Kanematsu, and United Grain Growers, said Kamran Khan, an official at the Pakistani embassy in Washington.
The lowest price in the tender was US $140.00 FOB per tonne, Khan said.
The majority of the U.S. tonnage will be shipped during August when new crop white wheat supplies will be available, Khan said.
